name: andrew54068
description: Claude Code plugins by Dawson: permission setup, browser MCP selection, security scanning, skills management, Ralph Loop prompts, open-source prep, and conversation previews.

plugins.name: permission-guardian
plugins.description: Analyzes project and generates Claude Code permissions for detected tech stacks.

plugins.name: browser-mcp-selector
plugins.description: Selects the best browser MCP tool for a given task based on requirements like cross-browser support, debugging depth, performance analysis, and login state needs.

plugins.name: security-scan
plugins.description: Comprehensive 6-agent parallel security scanner for Claude Code. Detects malicious code, credential leaks, data exfiltration, supply chain risks, and prompt injection attacks.

plugins.name: skills-manager
plugins.description: Manage per-project skills, plugins, and MCP servers via a bullpen + symlink pattern. Vendor-neutral path (~/.agents/) works for both Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: ralph-expert
plugins.description: Turn vague task ideas into well-structured Ralph Loop prompts. Generates completion criteria, suggests iteration limits, previews the full prompt, then launches the ralph-loop with safety nets. Requires the ralph-loop plugin.

plugins.name: open-source-prep
plugins.description: Prepare a private codebase for safe open-source release with secret scanning, license guidance, and standard repository documentation.

plugins.name: cc-preview
plugins.description: Preview the images and markdown files of a conversation in Claude Code: hover cards, pasted-image thumbnails above the prompt, and a side pane. Pictures show over ssh, and over mosh in block characters. Replaces tui-preview-mod.
